theory ctree_simon_weak_simulation
imports
  Main
  ctree_simon_bounded
  ctree_simon_refinement
begin

text ‹
  This is different notion of refinement based on simulation.
  The most important idea is that we can relate the two refinement concepts, trace and simulation.

  I explored this concept after the bind lemma for ‹⊑⇩t⇩r› was becoming too hard. The idea is to
  have a simulation proof method ‹⊑⇩s› that gives me ‹⊑⇩t⇩r›.

  This means two things:
  1. I need my relation to be coherent with trace inclusion.
  2. I need my relation to be weak.
  3. I need my relation to be divergent-sensitive.

  1 we axiomatize where needed, e.g. magic and diverge
  2 we get through an inductive-coinductive construction.
  3 we should get from the axiomatization.
›

text ‹
  The following relation is structural. It matches the same constructors on both sides
  and ignores a finite amount of silent steps.
›

inductive wsim_to :: "('e, 's, 'b) ctree ⇒ (('e, 's, 'b) ctree ⇒ ('e, 's, 'b) ctree ⇒ bool) ⇒ ('e, 's, 'b) ctree ⇒ bool" 
where
wsim_to_Ret :                         "wsim_to (Ret x) R (Ret x)" |
wsim_to_Sil1: "wsim_to P R Q       ⟹ wsim_to (Sil P) R Q" |
wsim_to_Sil2: "wsim_to P R Q       ⟹ wsim_to P       R (Sil Q)" |
wsim_to_Vis : "⟦ ∀ e . ∀ f ∈⇩b (F e). ∃ g ∈⇩b (G e). R f g ⟧ ⟹ wsim_to (Vis F) R (Vis G)" |
wsim_to_magic:                        "wsim_to magic R Q"

inductive_cases
  wsim_RetE_raw:     "wsim_to (Ret x) R P" and
  wsim_RetE_raw':    "wsim_to P       R (Ret x)" and
  wsim_SilE  [elim]: "wsim_to (Sil P) R Q" and
  wsim_SilE' [elim]: "wsim_to P       R (Sil Q)" and
  wsim_VisE  [elim]: "wsim_to (Vis P) R Q" and
  wsim_VisE' [elim]: "wsim_to P       R (Vis Q)"

lemma wsim_to_Vis_def:
  "wsim_to (Vis F) R (Vis G) ⟷ (∀ e P. P ∈⇩b (F e) ⟶ (∃ Q ∈⇩b (G e). R P Q))"
by (erule wsim_VisE; auto simp: ctree.inject magic_def)

lemma wsim_to_VisI:
  assumes "⋀ e P. P ∈⇩b (F e) ⟹ (∃ Q ∈⇩b (G e). R P Q)"
  shows "wsim_to (Vis F) R (Vis G)"
lemmas wsim_to_intros [intro] = wsim_to_Ret wsim_to_Sil1 wsim_to_Sil2 wsim_to_VisI wsim_to_magic

lemma wsim_to_induct [elim, consumes 1, case_names Ret Sil1 Sil2 Vis Magic]:
    assumes major: "wsim_to P R Q"
        and "⋀x R. φ (Ret x) R (Ret x)"
        and "(⋀P R Q. wsim_to P R Q ⟹ φ P R Q ⟹ φ (τ P) R Q)"
        and "(⋀P R Q. wsim_to P R Q ⟹ φ P R Q ⟹ φ P R (τ Q))"
        and "(⋀F R G. ∀x. (∀t∈⇩bF x. ∃x ∈⇩b G x. R t x) ⟹ φ (Vis F) R (Vis G))"
        and "⋀R Q. φ magic R Q"
      shows "φ P R Q"

lemma wsim_to_induct_fixed [elim, consumes 1, case_names Ret Sil1 Sil2 Vis Magic]:
    fixes R :: "('e, 'r) ctree['b] ⇒ ('e, 'r) ctree['b] ⇒ bool"
    assumes major: "wsim_to P R Q"
        and minor_Ret: "⋀x . φ (Ret x) (Ret x)"
        and minor_Sil1: "(⋀P Q. wsim_to P R Q ⟹ φ P Q ⟹ φ (τ P) Q)"
        and minor_Sil2: "(⋀P Q. wsim_to P R Q ⟹ φ P Q ⟹ φ P (τ Q))"
        and minor_Vis: "(⋀F G. ∀x. (∀t∈⇩bF x. ∃x ∈⇩b G x. R t x) ⟹ φ (Vis F) (Vis G))"
        and minor_Magic: "⋀Q. φ magic Q"
      shows "φ P Q"
proof (rule wsim_to.induct[where ?P="λ P R' Q. R' = R ⟶ φ P Q"])
assume "wsim_to P R' Q" and "R' = R ⟶ φ P Q"
assume "wsim_to P R' Q" and "R' = R ⟶ φ P Q"
assume "∀e. ∀f∈⇩bF e. ∃g ∈⇩b G e. R' f g"

lemma wsim_to_Sil_left_aux:
  "wsim_to X R Q ⟹ X = τ P ⟹ wsim_to P R Q"
by (induction rule: wsim_to.induct; auto simp add: magic_def)

lemma wsim_to_Sil_left [iff]:
  "wsim_to (τ P) R Q ⟷ wsim_to P R Q"

lemma wsim_to_Sil_right_aux:
  "wsim_to P R X ⟹ X = τ Q ⟹ wsim_to P R Q"

lemma wsim_to_Sil_right [iff]:
  "wsim_to P R (τ Q) ⟷ wsim_to P R Q"

lemma wsim_to_Sils_left [iff]:
  "wsim_to (Sils n P) R Q ⟷ wsim_to P R Q"

lemma wsim_to_Sils_right [iff]:
  "wsim_to P R (Sils n Q) ⟷ wsim_to P R Q"

lemma wsim_to_Ret_shape_aux:
  "wsim_to P R X ⟹ X = Ret x ⟹ (∃ n. P = Sils n (Ret x)) ∨ (∃ n. P = Sils n magic)"
consider (ret) "∃ n. P' = Sils n (Ret x)" | (mag) "∃ n. P' = Sils n magic"
obtain n where "P' = Sils n (Ret x)"
by (intro disjI1 exI[where x = "Suc n"]; simp)
obtain n where "P' = Sils n magic"
by (intro disjI2 exI[where x = "Suc n"]; simp)

lemma wsim_to_Ret_shape [iff]:
  "wsim_to P R (Ret x) ⟷ (∃ n. P = Sils n (Ret x)) ∨ (∃ n. P = Sils n magic)"

lemma wsim_to_Vis_shape_aux:
  "wsim_to P R X ⟹ X = Vis K ⟹
    P = magic ∨ (∃ n F. P = Sils n (Vis F) ∧ (∀ e. ∀ f ∈⇩b F e. ∃ g ∈⇩b K e. R f g))"

lemma wsim_to_Vis_shape:
  "wsim_to P R (Vis K) ⟹
    P = magic ∨ (∃ n F. P = Sils n (Vis F) ∧ (∀ e. ∀ f ∈⇩b F e. ∃ g ∈⇩b K e. R f g))"

lemma wsim_to_Vis_left_shape_aux:
  "wsim_to P R X ⟹ P = Vis G ⟹
    (∃ n H. X = Sils n (Vis H) ∧ (∀ e. ∀ g ∈⇩b G e. ∃ h ∈⇩b H e. R g h))
    ∨ (∀ e. G e = {}⇩b)"

consider
    (shape) "∃ n H. Q = Sils n (Vis H) ∧ (∀ e. ∀ g ∈⇩b G e. ∃ a ∈⇩b H e. R g a)"
  | (empty) "∀ e. G e = {}⇩b"
obtain n H where "Q = Sils n (Vis H)" "∀ e. ∀ g ∈⇩b G e. ∃ a ∈⇩b H e. R g a"
by (intro disjI1 exI[where ?x="Suc n"] exI[where ?x=H]; simp)
by (intro disjI1 exI[where x = 0] exI[where x = G]; auto)

lemma wsim_to_Vis_left_shape:
  "wsim_to (Vis G) R X ⟹
    (∃ n H. X = Sils n (Vis H) ∧ (∀ e. ∀ g ∈⇩b G e. ∃ h ∈⇩b H e. R g h)) ∨ (∀ e. G e = {}⇩b) "

lemma wsim_to_trans [trans]:
  assumes "wsim_to P A Q" and "wsim_to Q A R" and "transp A"
  shows "wsim_to P A R"

consider
    (shape) "∃ n H. R = Sils n (Vis H) ∧ (∀ e. ∀ g ∈⇩b G e. ∃ h ∈⇩b H e. A g h)"
  | (empty) "∀ e. G e = {}⇩b"

obtain n H where
      hR    : "R = Sils n (Vis H)" and
      G_to_H: "∀ e. ∀ g ∈⇩b G e. ∃ h ∈⇩b H e. A g h"
obtain P' where "P' ∈⇩b G e" and "A P P'"
obtain P'' where "P'' ∈⇩b H e" and "A P' P''"
show "∃ Q ∈⇩b H e. A P Q"

lemma monotonic_wsim_to:
  "wsim_to P R⇩1 Q ⟹ R⇩1 ≤ R⇩2 ⟹ wsim_to P R⇩2 Q"
apply (smt (verit, best) bBex_mono bbspec predicate2D_obj wsim_to_VisI)

lemma mono_wbisim_to [mono add]:
  "R⇩1 ≤ R⇩2 ⟹ (λ P Q. wsim_to P R⇩1 Q) ≤ (λ P Q. wsim_to P R⇩2 Q)"

lemma wsim_to_refl [intro]:
  assumes hR: "reflp R" and hP: "stabilises P"
  shows "wsim_to P R P"
obtain n P' where hSils: "P = Sils n P'" and hstable: "stable P'"

text ‹
  Here we lift the weak-simulation to the GFP. The additional axiom is  wsim_diverge
  as it's the only one that requires coinductive reasoning and is not structural.
›

coinductive wsim :: "('e, 'e) ctree['b] ⇒ ('e, 'e) ctree['b] ⇒ bool" (infix "≲" 50) where
  wsimI: "wsim_to P wsim Q ⟹ wsim P Q" |
  wsim_diverge [intro]: "wsim P diverge" ― ‹top of lattice refinement. Cannot be eliminated›

theorem wsim_coind [elim, consumes 1, case_names wsim, induct pred: "wsim"]:
 assumes major: "φ P Q"
     and minor: "(⋀P Q. φ P Q ⟹ (wsim_to P (λ P Q. φ P Q ∨ wsim P Q) Q) ∨ P = magic ∨ Q = diverge)"
   shows "wsim P Q"

text ‹
  The following lemmas prove that @{term wsim} is indeed divergence sensitive.

  This means that @{term "diverge ≲ P"} implies ‹P = diverge›.
›

lemma A:
  "wsim_to P R Q ⟹ P = diverge ⟹ Q = diverge"

lemma A' [iff]:
  "wsim diverge Q ⟷ Q = diverge"

lemma wsim_cases [consumes 1, case_names Base Magic Diverge]:
  assumes major: "wsim P Q"
      and minor_wsim_to : "⟦ P≠ magic; Q ≠ diverge; wsim_to P wsim Q ⟧ ⟹ R"
      and minor_magic : "⟦ P = magic ⟧ ⟹ R"
      and minor_diverge : "⟦ Q = diverge ⟧ ⟹ R"
    shows R

lemma wsim_iff [iff]:
  "wsim P Q ⟷ P = magic ∨ Q = diverge ∨ (P ≠ magic) ∧ (Q ≠ diverge) ∧ wsim_to P wsim Q"
apply (cases P'; auto simp add: wsim_to_Vis_def)

lemma wsim_trans [trans]:
  assumes hPQ: "wsim P Q" and hQR: "wsim Q R"
  shows "wsim P R"
have "∃ M. wsim P M ∧ wsim M R"
proof (rule wsim_coind[where φ = "λ P R. ∃ M. wsim P M ∧ wsim M R"])
assume "∃ M. wsim t M ∧ wsim M u"
obtain M where hPM: "wsim t M" and hMR: "wsim M u"
show "wsim_to t (λ P Q. (∃ M. wsim P M ∧ wsim M Q) ∨ wsim P Q) u ∨ t = magic ∨ u = diverge"
have "wsim_to t (λ P Q. (∃ M. wsim P M ∧ wsim M Q) ∨ wsim P Q) u"

obtain n H where
            hU  : "u = Sils n (Vis H)" and
            hGH : "∀ e. ∀ g ∈⇩b G e. ∃ h ∈⇩b H e. wsim g h"

lemma wsim_ctrace:
  assumes "wsim P Q" "ctrace_of P tr"
  shows "ctrace_of Q tr"
have init: ‹∃ P'. wsim P' Q ∧ ctrace_of P' tr›
proof (rule ctrace_of_coind[where φ = "λ Q tr. ∃ P'. wsim P' Q ∧ ctrace_of P' tr"])
show "∃ P'. wsim P' Q ∧ ctrace_of P' tr"
(* Ret case: Q = Ret x forces the trace to be Term x *)
assume "∃ P'. wsim P' (Ret x) ∧ ctrace_of P' tr"
obtain P' where sim: "wsim P' (Ret x)" and htr: "ctrace_of P' tr"
by (metis ctrace_Ret ctrace_of_Sils ctrace_of_magic diverge_not_Ret wsim_iff wsim_to_Ret_shape)
have "wsim_to P' wsim (Ret x) ∨ P' = magic"
obtain n where "P' = Sils n (Ret x)"
(* Sil case: strip the silent step on Q's side *)
assume "∃ P'. wsim P' (τ Q') ∧ ctrace_of P' tr"
obtain P' where sim: "wsim P' (τ Q')" and htr: "ctrace_of P' tr"
have "P' = magic ∨  τ Q' = diverge ∨ wsim_to P' wsim (τ Q')"
show "(∃ P'. wsim P' Q' ∧ ctrace_of P' tr) ∨ ctrace_of Q' tr"
(* Vis case: find the matching successor via the simulation *)
assume "∃ P'. wsim P' (Vis K) ∧ ctrace_of P' tr"
obtain P' where sim: "wsim P' (Vis K)" and htr: "ctrace_of P' tr"

obtain n F
      where shape: "P' = Sils n (Vis F)"
        and match: "∀ e. ∀ f ∈⇩b F e. ∃ g ∈⇩b K e. wsim f g"

obtain e tr' f
      where ev: "tr = TCons e tr'" and mem: "f ∈⇩b F e" and tf: "ctrace_of f tr'"
obtain g where gK: "g ∈⇩b K e" and sg: "wsim f g"

show "∃ e tr'. tr = TCons e tr' ∧
            (∃ P'' ∈⇩b K e. (∃ P'. wsim P' P'' ∧ ctrace_of P' tr') ∨ ctrace_of P'' tr')"

lemma wsim_sound:
  assumes "wsim P Q"
  shows "P ⊑⇩t⇩r Q"

lemma wsim_complete:
  assumes "P ⊑⇩t⇩r Q"
  shows "wsim P Q"
(* usual coffee machine example shows that this fails *)

experiment (* simulation argument for bind, assume, assert *)
begin

lemma
  assumes "P ⟹ wsim (Ret ()) Q"
  shows "wsim (ASSUME P) Q"

lemma wsim_ASSERT:
  assumes "P" and "wsim (Ret ()) Q"
  shows "wsim (ASSERT P) Q"

lemma
  assumes "P ⟹ wsim (R ()) Q"
  shows "wsim (ASSUME P ⤜ R) Q"

lemma
  assumes "P" and "wsim (R ()) Q"
  shows "wsim (ASSERT P ⤜ R) Q"

lemma wsim_bind_head:
  assumes "wsim P P'"
  shows "wsim (P ⤜ Q) (P' ⤜ Q)"
have "P = magic ∨ P' = diverge ∨ wsim_to P wsim P'"
proof (coinduction arbitrary: P P' rule: wsim_coind)

proof (elim disjE)
        ― ‹Case 1: P = magic, so P ⤜ Q = magic›

next
        ― ‹Case 2: P' = diverge, so P' ⤜ Q = diverge›

next
        ― ‹Case 3: structural, induct over the wsim_to proof›
        ― ‹Working directly on ?case preserves the ∨ magic ∨ diverge escape needed in Ret›

proof (induction rule: wsim_to_induct_fixed)
          ― ‹Ret x: both sides reduce to Q x›
          ― ‹wsim (Q x) (Q x) from wsim_refl; case split via wsim_iff, then monotonicity›
have "Q x = magic ∨ Q x = diverge ∨ wsim_to (Q x) wsim (Q x)"
have "wsim_to (Ret x ⤜ Q) (λP Qa. (∃Pa P'. P = Pa ⤜ Q ∧ Qa = P' ⤜ Q ∧ (Pa = magic ∨ P' = diverge ∨ wsim_to Pa wsim P')) ∨ wsim P Qa) (Ret x ⤜ Q)"

next
          ― ‹Sil on left: τ P₀ ⤜ Q = τ (P₀ ⤜ Q); wsim_to_Sil_left strips τ, IH closes›
assume "wsim_to (P ⤜ Q) (λP Qa. (∃Pa P'. P = Pa ⤜ Q ∧ Qa = P' ⤜ Q ∧ (Pa = magic ∨ P' = diverge ∨ wsim_to Pa wsim P')) ∨ wsim P Qa) (P' ⤜ Q)"
have "wsim_to (τ P ⤜ Q) (λP Qa. (∃Pa P'. P = Pa ⤜ Q ∧ Qa = P' ⤜ Q ∧ (Pa = magic ∨ P' = diverge ∨ wsim_to Pa wsim P')) ∨ wsim P Qa) (P' ⤜ Q)"
assume "wsim_to P wsim P'" and "P ⤜ Q = magic"
have "P = magic ∨ (∃ n x. P = Sils n (Ret x) ∧ Q x = magic)"
have "wsim_to magic (λP Qa. (∃Pa P'. P = Pa ⤜ Q ∧ Qa = P' ⤜ Q ∧ (Pa = magic ∨ P' = diverge ∨ wsim_to Pa wsim P')) ∨ wsim P Qa) (P' ⤜ Q)"
with ‹wsim_to P wsim P'› and wsim_to_Vis_left_shape_aux
obtain n H where "P' = Sils n (Vis H) ∧ (∀ e. ∀ g ∈⇩b {}⇩b. ∃ h ∈⇩b H e. wsim g h)"
have "P' ⤜ Q = Sils n (Vis (map_bset (λ ck. ck ⤜ Q) o H))"
assume "∃ n x. P = Sils n (Ret x) ∧ Q x = magic"
obtain n x where "P = Sils n (Ret x)" and "Q x = magic"
from ‹wsim_to P wsim P'› and ‹P = Sils n (Ret x)›
have "∃ m. P' = Sils m (Ret x)"
by (metis B Sil1.hyps ctrace_of_Term_simps ctrace_refinement_def wsimI wsim_sound)
obtain m where "P' = Sils m (Ret x)"
using ‹P ⤜ Q = Sils n magic› ‹P' ⤜ Q = Sils m magic›
assume "wsim_to P wsim P'" and "P' ⤜ Q = diverge"

next 
          ― ‹Sil on left: τ P₀ ⤜ Q = τ (P₀ ⤜ Q); wsim_to_Sil_left strips τ, IH closes›
assume "wsim_to (P ⤜ Q) (λP Qa. (∃Pa P'. P = Pa ⤜ Q ∧ Qa = P' ⤜ Q ∧ (Pa = magic ∨ P' = diverge ∨ wsim_to Pa wsim P')) ∨ wsim P Qa) (P' ⤜ Q)"
have "wsim_to (P ⤜ Q) (λP Qa. (∃Pa P'. P = Pa ⤜ Q ∧ Qa = P' ⤜ Q ∧ (Pa = magic ∨ P' = diverge ∨ wsim_to Pa wsim P')) ∨ wsim P Qa) (τ P' ⤜ Q)"
assume "wsim_to P wsim P'" and "P ⤜ Q = magic"
have "P = magic ∨ (∃ n x. P = Sils n (Ret x) ∧ Q x = magic)"
have "wsim_to magic (λP Qa. (∃Pa P'. P = Pa ⤜ Q ∧ Qa = P' ⤜ Q ∧ (Pa = magic ∨ P' = diverge ∨ wsim_to Pa wsim P')) ∨ wsim P Qa) (P' ⤜ Q)"
with ‹wsim_to P wsim P'› and wsim_to_Vis_left_shape_aux
obtain n H where "P' = Sils n (Vis H) ∧ (∀ e. ∀ g ∈⇩b {}⇩b. ∃ h ∈⇩b H e. wsim g h)"
have "P' ⤜ Q = Sils n (Vis (map_bset (λ ck. ck ⤜ Q) o H))"
assume "∃ n x. P = Sils n (Ret x) ∧ Q x = magic"
obtain n x where "P = Sils n (Ret x)" and "Q x = magic"
from ‹wsim_to P wsim P'› and ‹P = Sils n (Ret x)›
have "∃ m. P' = Sils m (Ret x)"
by (metis B Sil2.hyps ctrace_of_Term_simps ctrace_refinement_def wsimI wsim_sound)
obtain m where "P' = Sils m (Ret x)"
using ‹P ⤜ Q = Sils n magic› ‹P' ⤜ Q = Sils m magic›
assume "wsim_to P wsim P'" and "P' ⤜ Q = diverge"

next
          ― ‹Vis: Vis F ⤜ Q = Vis (map_bset (λf. f ⤜ Q) ∘ F); match each continuation›
have step: "⋀e ck. ck ∈⇩b F e ⟹ ∃ck' ∈⇩b G e. ck ≲ ck'"
have hF: "Vis F ⤜ Q = Vis (map_bset (λck. ck ⤜ Q) ∘ F)"
have hG: "Vis G ⤜ Q = Vis (map_bset (λck. ck ⤜ Q) ∘ G)"
